description: This file contains step definitions and utility functions for testing tag expressions within a behavior-driven development (BDD) framework using 'behave'. It defines classes, converters, and step implementations for testing tag logic and model element selection based on tags.

classes.name: ModelElement
classes.description: Represents a model element with a name and associated tags.

methods.name: convert_tag_expression
methods.description: Converts a text string into a tag expression object using 'make_tag_expression'.

methods.name: convert_yesno
methods.description: Converts a 'yes'/'no' string into a boolean value.

methods.name: step_given_the_tag_expression
methods.description: Defines a tag expression for later use in tests.

methods.name: step_given_the_default_tag_expression
methods.description: Sets default tags as a tag expression if none is already set.

methods.name: step_then_tag_expression_selects_elements_with_tags
methods.description: Checks if the tag expression correctly selects elements with specified tags.

methods.name: step_given_named_model_elements_with_tags
methods.description: Creates model elements with specified names and tags for testing.

methods.name: step_then_tag_expression_selects_model_elements_with
methods.description: Verifies that the tag expression selects the correct model elements based on tags.
